news.title: Employees of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine awarded the Z.I. Nekrasov Prize
news.text: Employees of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine Dr. Sc. (Tech.), Sen. Res. O.I. Babachenko, Dr. Sc. (Tech.), Sen. Res. H.A. Kononenko, PhD in Philology R.V. Podolskyi were awarded the Z.I. Nekrasov Prize – for outstanding scientific works in the field of metallurgy

children.value: On April 24, 2024, a regular session of the General Meeting of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine took place in Kyiv. During the reporting session, the President of the Academy of Sciences of Ukraine Anatolii Zavhorodnii
presented diplomas to the laureates of the prizes named after outstanding scientists of Ukraine based on the results of the 2023 competition

. Among the laureates were employees of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute, who were awarded the Z.I. Nekrasov Prize for outstanding scientific works in the field of metallurgy for the cycle of scientific works 'Development of technological parameters for the production of railway-purpose metal products and quality assessment criteria that ensure increased reliability and durability'. The author team: Director of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Technical Sciences
Oleksandr Babachenko
; Scientific Secretary of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Technical Sciences
Hanna Kononenko
; Research Fellow of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Philosophy
Rostyslav Podolskyi

content.value: /newspics/2-2.jpeg
President of the NAS of Ukraine Anatolii ZAVHORODNII presents a diploma to the Director of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine Oleksandr BABACHENKO

news.title: Congratulations to the Director of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine Dr. Sc. (Tech.), Sen. Res. O.I. Babachenko on his election as a Corresponding Member of the NAS of Ukraine

Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Technical Sciences Oleksandr Ivanovych Babachenko was elected a Corresponding Member of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine

content.value: On April 25, 2024, a session of the General Meeting of the NAS of Ukraine took place, during which the Director of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Technical Sciences Oleksandr Ivanovych Babachenko was elected to the vacant position of Corresponding Member of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine in the specialty 'Materials Science, Technology of Materials'.

Congratulations on the recognition of your significant contribution to the development of science, many years of fruitful work, deep scientific erudition and leadership in your field.
We wish you endless inspiration, inexhaustible energy, interesting ideas on the path to new scientific heights!

news.title: Update of ATEX © software
news.text: On August 15, 2024, the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine received an official license for the non-commercial use of ATEX© software

children.value: On August 15, 2024, the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine received an official license for the non-commercial use of
ATEX©
software, which will contribute to improving the quality of scientific research and training of postgraduate students.
The receipt of the license for
ATEX© software

by the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine is a significant step in improving scientific work. This software allows for detailed analysis of electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction results, which will help the Institute's employees research the unique structural features of steels and alloys of new chemical compositions. Furthermore, this tool significantly simplifies the confirmation of existing effects in steels, cast irons and other alloys, and contributes to the professional development of postgraduate students and scientists, who now gain access to modern analysis methods.

news.title: Participation of employees of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine in the 7th International Conference 'WRT2024' in Yaremche

news.title: Participation of employees of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine in the international conference 'Innovative Manufacturing Engineering & Energy 2024', Athens, Greece
news.text: Participation of employees of the ISI of the NAS of Ukraine in the work of the conference 'Innovative Manufacturing Engineering & Energy 2024', Athens, Greece

content.value: From October 23 to 25, 2024, the international conference Innovative Manufacturing Engineering & Energy 2024 (IMANEE2024) took place in the capital of Greece, Athens. This event brought together leading scientists from around the world to discuss current issues in the field of innovative manufacturing and energy.

children.value: At the conference, the Head of the Department of Problems of Deformation-Thermal Treatment of Structural Steels, Doctor of Technical Sciences
Hanna KONONENKO
, and a Research Fellow of the same department, Doctor of Philosophy
Rostyslav PODOLSKYI
, presented the results of the work of the team of authors: Adjams'kyi S.V. (Dnipro), Dovhyi B.T. (Warsaw), Kononenko H.A. (Dnipro), Karmyris-Orbatanskyi P. (Krakow), Podolskyi R.V. (Dnipro).

content.value: Report topic: 'Peculiarities of the evolution of the microstructure and mechanical properties depending on the correction of the focal length in parts made by laser melting in a powder layer.'

The report highlighted the results of research in the field of additive manufacturing, in particular, the influence of correcting the focal length of the laser beam on the evolution of the microstructure and mechanical properties of parts manufactured by laser powder bed fusion.
/newspics/8-2.jpg

This conference became a unique platform for presenting the scientific achievements of our Institute at the international level, exchanging experience with colleagues from different countries, as well as for establishing new scientific contacts.
We express our sincere gratitude to the IMANEE2024 organizing committee for the opportunity to present the results of our team's work at this important event.

news.title: PhD student Ihor Liubeka successfully completed the international Science2Business program
news.text: PhD student Ihor Liubeka successfully completed the international Science2Business program

content.value: On July 10, 2025, PhD student of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Ihor Liubeka, successfully completed the intensive Science2Business (S2B) training program and received an official certificate.

The program lasted 7 weeks (60 hours) in an online format and was organized within the framework of the European Seeds of Bravery initiative, supported by the European Innovation Council (EIC) and funded by the European Union. Leading partners such as INNOU8, Aalto University, EIT Health, and Erasmus Centre for Entrepreneurship participated in its implementation.
/newspics/13-2.png
About the Science2Business program
Science2Business aims to help young scientists and innovators transform scientific ideas into commercially viable business solutions. The course covered the following key areas:

children.value: development of entrepreneurial competencies,
formation of innovation ecosystems
inclusive entrepreneurship
project scaling
The classes were conducted by international experts and mentors, including representatives of
Erasmus Centre for Entrepreneurship
, who have extensive experience in entrepreneurship and innovation.

content.value: /newspics/13-3.png

children.value: The participation of Ihor Liubeka in the
Science2Business

program opens new opportunities for integrating the scientific results obtained at the Iron and Steel Institute into the global innovation space. It also contributes to strengthening the role of Ukrainian researchers in the development of high-tech industries and the creation of competitive, science-intensive products.

news.title: ISM NAS of Ukraine received the highest category “A” based on the results of the state certification
news.text: The Z.I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine has successfully passed the state certification and received the highest category “A”

content.value: On 2 October 2025, the Z.I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine successfully completed the state certification for 2020–2025 in the scientific field of "Engineering and Technological Sciences". Based on the evaluation results of the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine, the Institute was awarded the highest category – “A”, which confirms the high level of scientific and innovation activity, the competitiveness of its scientific results, compliance with international quality standards and active integration into the European research area.
/newspics/15/15-2.png
Results of the state certification of research institutions and higher education institutions in the area “Engineering and Technological Sciences”

This result is a recognition of the many years of dedicated work of the staff of the ICM NAS of Ukraine and their significant contribution to the development of fundamental and applied science in the fields of metallurgy, materials science and mechanical engineering. During the reporting period, the Institute implemented a number of important research projects, concluded dozens of contractual topics, published monographs, obtained patents, expanded international cooperation and trained highly qualified personnel.

The high performance achieved demonstrates the diligent work, professionalism, scientific dedication and commitment to development of the Institute’s employees. The achievements of the team form the basis for the sustainable development of the institution and represent a significant contribution to strengthening science and the economic security of Ukraine. May the scientific potential continue to grow, innovative projects be successfully implemented and new results be achieved in the coming years.

news.title: Symposium Held Within the IX International Conference “HighMatTech-2025”
news.text: A symposium within the IX International Conference “HighMatTech-2025” was held at the Z.I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine

children.value: From 6 to 10 October 2025, the IX International Conference on Materials Science
HighMatTech-2025

took place. The event was organized by the Ukrainian Materials Research Society named after I.M. Frantsevich in cooperation with leading scientific institutions of Ukraine. The conference was held in a network format with several offline locations — in Kyiv, Lviv, Dnipro, and Kharkiv.

content.value: One of the central locations of the conference was the Z.I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine (Dnipro), where the symposium sessions on “Metals and Alloys” were conducted.
/newspics/16/16-2.JPG
Section presentations and discussions within the “Metals and Alloys” track

The conference focused on the exchange of scientific ideas, discussion of modern research, and strengthening cooperation between scientists and industry representatives in the field of materials science. The thematic scope covered a wide range of topics — from metals, composite materials, ceramics, and glass to nanomaterials, thin films, coatings, and hydrogen materials science.
Invited experts from leading scientific and industrial institutions from Germany, Austria, the United Kingdom, Poland, Sweden, and other countries presented their research during the event.
The “HighMatTech-2025” conference reaffirmed its status as an important platform for knowledge exchange, establishing international cooperation, and developing new directions in materials science.

The Z.I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine expresses its gratitude to the organizers, partners, and participants for their active engagement, constructive discussions, and contribution to the development of the Ukrainian materials science school.

news.title: Excursion to the Museum of Ferrous Metallurgy
news.text: An excursion to the Museum of Ferrous Metallurgy of IFM took place

content.value: On November 27, 2025, as part of the events dedicated to the International Day of Engagement in Science for Sustainable Development, an excursion to the Museum of Ferrous Metallurgy took place.

The Museum of Ferrous Metallurgy, located in the central building of IFM, has a unique exhibition dedicated to the achievements of domestic metallurgical scientists, the evolution of blast furnace, steelmaking and rolling production, as well as modern trends in the development of the industry.

Employees of IFM, postgraduate students and students listened with great interest to the story about the history of the development of Ukraine’s metallurgical industry, outstanding metallurgical scientists and metallurgical dynasties of the Dnipropetrovsk region, its scientific and technical potential and its role in shaping the industrial power of the state.

In addition to a rich collection of documents and photographs, the museum has several stands featuring working models of metallurgical equipment — blast furnace No. 9 of Kryvorizhstal, a hot metal desulfurization unit, rolling mills and others — which clearly demonstrate the features of various metallurgical processes.

news.title: Admission announcement for PhD and Doctoral studies
news.text: The Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine announces admission to PhD (G10 Metallurgy, G8 Materials Science) and Doctoral programs.

content.value: The Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine (IChM) announces admission to PhD studies in the specialties G10 “Metallurgy” and G8 “Materials Science”.
PhD admission in 2026
PhD admission in 2026 includes the following entrance examinations:

children.value: Unified Entrance Exam (EVI) — administered by the Ukrainian Center for Educational Quality Assessment; consists of two parts: General Academic Competence Test (TZNK) and a foreign language test (English, German, French, Spanish — applicant’s choice).
Unified Entrance Test (EVV) — administered by the Ukrainian Center for Educational Quality Assessment: a test in research methodology.
Specialty exam and presentation of a research proposal — organized and conducted by the higher education institution.
Additional exam — conducted by the institution if the admission specialty does not match the specialty in the master’s/specialist diploma (to be admitted to the main examinations).

content.value: Admission to the competitive selection is granted provided the applicant obtains:

children.value: at least 300 points for the two EVI parts (compensation is possible, e.g., 140 + 160 points);
at least 100 points for the EVV.

content.value: Recognition of previous years’ results: EVI certificates from 2024 and 2025, and EVV from 2025 are valid.
Application and examination timeline

children.value: PhD applications — via the applicant’s electronic account on the Unified State Electronic Education Database website, from August 7 to August 25;
institutional entrance examinations — August 26 to September 7;
enrollment of applicants who confirmed their choice of place of study — by September 14.

content.value: Doctoral admission

The Institute also announces admission to Doctoral studies in the specialties 05.16.01 — Materials Science and Heat Treatment of Metals; 05.16.02 — Metallurgy of Ferrous and Non-Ferrous Metals and Special Alloys.
Applicant requirements:

children.value: a PhD (Candidate of Sciences) degree;
research achievements and publications in the chosen specialty (including in international peer-reviewed journals indexed in scientometric databases);
research results that require completion or formalization as a dissertation, monograph, or scientific report based on a set of articles.

content.value: Those who wish to participate in the competition should send by May 12 a candidate information sheet describing the applicant and their research activity, signed by a prospective scientific consultant, to: office.isi@nas.gov.ua.

Within one month from the date of receiving the documents, the Academic Council of IChM of the NAS of Ukraine will hear the applicants’ scientific presentations, conduct an interview, and decide by vote on the possibility of admission.

news.title: All-Ukrainian science popularization initiative «Material World»
news.text: On June 2, 2026, students from Dnipro schools visited the Z. I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine as part of the «Material World» initiative.

content.value: /newspics/31/31-1.jpg

As part of the all-Ukrainian science popularization initiative «Material World», organized by the Ukrainian Materials Research Society, leading scientific institutions in Dnipro, Kyiv, Lviv, Kharkiv, and Lutsk opened their doors to young researchers.
/newspics/31/31-2.jpg

On June 2, 2026, students from KZO «NFML» DOR, Lyceum No. 28 of the Dnipro City Council, and Slobozhanske Lyceum of the Slobozhanske Settlement Council visited the Z. I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine. The event aimed to introduce schoolchildren to advanced achievements in materials science and engineering, as well as to promote STEM education among young people.
/newspics/31/31-3.jpg
Schoolchildren visited the Z. I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine
/newspics/31/31-4.jpg
Greetings to participants from different cities via video conference

During the excursion to the Institute, the students learned how pig iron and steel are produced, what stages metal goes through from ore to finished product, and why the properties of materials play a key role in the development of modern technologies.

Staff of the State Museum of Metallurgy of Ukraine talk about the metallurgy of our region

content.value: A visit to the metallographic laboratory aroused particular interest, allowing participants to look behind the scenes of scientific research. The children learned how samples are prepared for studies, became familiar with metallographic analysis methods, and compared the structure of different materials under a microscope. The students also visited the mechanical testing laboratory, where they learned about the main methods for determining mechanical properties and how the reliability of metals for industrial use is assessed.

news.title: Competition announced for the position of Head of the Laboratory of Heat Engineering and Energy-Saving Technologies of Blast Furnace Production
news.text: The Z. I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine announces a competitive selection for the scientific position of Head of the Laboratory of Heat Engineering and Energy-Saving Technologies of Blast Furnace Production of the Department of Pig Iron Metallurgy. The competition is announced from August 5, 2026. The application deadline is September 5, 2026.

content.value: In accordance with the Order of the Presidium of the NAS of Ukraine No. 553 dated 04.10.2018 (as amended by the Order of the Presidium of the NAS of Ukraine No. 226 dated 20.04.2021), the Z. I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine announces a competitive selection for the scientific position of Head of the Laboratory of Heat Engineering and Energy-Saving Technologies of Blast Furnace Production of the Department of Pig Iron Metallurgy.
The competition is announced from August 5, 2026. The final deadline for submitting applications for admission to the competition is September 5, 2026.

A competition commission has been established for the preliminary discussion of applicants for vacant research positions. The chair of the commission is the Deputy Director of IChM, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher E. V. Parusov.

A Doctor of Sciences or a Doctor of Philosophy (Candidate of Sciences) may apply for the vacant scientific position of Head of the Laboratory. The candidate must have scientific results whose quantity and quality correspond to the level of the vacant scientific position and the specifics of the relevant research area.
List of documents (for IChM employees)

children.value: a written application to participate in the competition addressed to the chair of the competition commission;
copies of documents confirming the academic degree and academic title;
a list of scientific works and patents for inventions that have undergone qualification examination over the last five years.

content.value: List of documents (for candidates who do not work at IChM)

children.value: a written application to participate in the competition addressed to the chair of the competition commission;
a copy of an identity document;
a completed personal record card (questionnaire) of the established form;
an autobiography;
a copy of the employment record book;
copies of documents on higher education, advanced training, awarding of an academic degree, conferral of an academic title, and military registration documents;
a list of scientific works and patents for inventions that have undergone qualification examination over the last five years;
written consent to the processing of personal data.

content.value: Documents may be submitted in person, sent by post, or emailed. Documents submitted by email must be provided as scanned PDF files, with each document as a separate file.

Candidates may provide additional information about their education, work experience, professional level and reputation (references, recommendations, etc.), as well as their vision for the development of research and developments in the position.
Contacts
All applications are registered with the Academic Secretary of the Institute, L. I. Harmash. Tel.: 790-05-15. E-mail: office.isi@nas.gov.ua
